dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the cats...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, I saw a girl trying to give them some milk while I was on morning patrol...ACHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Thank goodness I was able to stop her. Well, not that she meant them any ill, but cats will get upset stomachs from drinking milk!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: ...Maybe it's because I've been around cats for so long, but I've also stopped liking milk myself. Here, you take them...ACHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Hello tra—a—achoo!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Sorry... Can I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: I'm fine, thanks for your concern... achoo!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Terribly sorry, it's that season again and Butch is molting. This normally doesn't ha—a—achoo!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Have a nice trACHOO! Trip.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's Butch?

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Butch is the fiercest and strongest of all the cats here. The ginger one, and it's a she by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: I have names for all the cats here. Look, that's Jen-Jen, and there's Ogre Face and Cinnamon Bun...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: They come over when I call them now... Achoo!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You sure this is nothing serious?

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Yes; I'm fine, I'm fine... Just a little bit allergic. It's only a... phew... little hai—hai—hairs, I can ha—a—andle it... ACHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seen anyone around who looks a fair bit like me?

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Ahhchoo! ...I've been patrolling the wharf the whole time, but I can't say I've seen anyone who looks like you.

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I could always have missed something...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: After sticking with the cats for too long, I've gotten bad at remembering faces. I even mistook our sergeant for some old fellow asking for directions...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Ah... Ah... I will keep a look out when I'm on patrol in future. While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevACHOO!
